space.description: Space the path belongs to; omitted when the signer is the space owner.

path.description: Document path within the space, starting with `/`; empty for the home document.

genesisBlob.description: CID of the genesis Change of the document at this address.

capability.description: Informational CID of the capability authorizing the signer; the daemon ignores it.

heads.description: CIDs of the document's current head Changes; empty for a tombstone or redirect.

redirect.description: Where readers are sent instead, making this Ref a redirect.

generation.description: Orders the lives of an address: the highest generation wins; clients use the current time in ms for a new document.

visibility.description: Empty for public or `Private`; a private Ref must have a single-segment path.

description: A signed claim that a path in a space points at a document's current head Changes, or that it is deleted or redirects elsewhere.
